scope: rights-and-provenance qualification of the committed 8-generation FamilySearch material-evidence corpus (809 cohort persons, 13,249 unique records) — classifies every committed layer and every local-only tier for permanent-network (ANT) replication suitability

orders.harvest: founder 2026-09-18 — scrape every bit of familysearch.com material evidence for at least 8 dead (grandparents on) blood relative generations; stage here, github, later ANT (executed by the zBlood lane, dispatch 2026-09-18-zblood-source-harvest-8gen.md)
orders.retain: founder 2026-10-17 — we keep everything harvested thus far; no re-harvest, no deletions; the corpus as committed stands
orders.context: founder 2026-10-17 — the family are original investors to the LDS church; recorded as custodian-relationship CONTEXT for the church-record material, not as a rights grant (no document conferring one is in evidence)

axes.copyright: facts (names, dates, places, relationships) and short factual citations/pointers are not copyrightable expression; verbatim record images and prose transcriptions are licensed custodian content
axes.contract: FamilySearch Terms of Use §83 prohibits bulk harvesting/scraping without written permission; the corpus was acquired over the founder's own signed-in session via the site's own wires — recorded here as acquisition fact, per the retain order it is not being litigated or undone by this qualification
axes.custodian: record images and wholesale index republication are restricted by FamilySearch's record-custodian agreements (their published guidance permits personal genealogical research use, not republication of images or wholesale indexing)
axes.privacy: living persons — separate gate from rights; estate privacy law already keeps living-flagged material unnamed/unkeyed in public layers and full-fidelity tiers box-local

classes.F-family-facts: genealogical facts and estate-authored analysis (person conclusions, relationship audit reasoning, harvest receipts) — estate's own work product over uncopyrightable facts
classes.P-pointers: citation strings, collection titles, ark URLs, film/record ids, attachment dates, image digests — short factual pointers with attribution inherent (they name FamilySearch, the collection, and the access date)
classes.I-fs-index-data: FamilySearch record-service index-field triplets {factType, fieldType, value} and hint metadata — bulk-extracted database content; values are facts but the extraction is the contract/custodian axis
classes.B-image-bytes: record image bytes (deepzoom tile assemblies) — custodian-licensed; never committed, box-local only
classes.R-private-tier: full-fidelity raw dump, notes, change messages, contributor ids, living-household arrays — box-local by estate privacy law

index.json.basis: 809 persons keyed by internal iid; per-source citation strings + affected conclusions + attachment dates — facts and pointers

search-evidence.json.basis: search-derived citations for the two zero-attached-source grandparents; obituary/household TEXT stayed private-tier at harvest (dispatch 2026-09-18)

images-summary.json.basis: counts, dims, sha256 digests, ark/apid pointers, method/boundary prose — zero image bytes; its own boundary field states bytes are private-tier only

records.json.basis: 13,249 records: citation/title/event layers are pointers; evidence[] carries 49,342 FS index-field triplets — held from ANT pending the Class-I ruling

sources-sync-2026-10-12.json.basis: 11 persons, 37 newSources, 153 index-field triplets (post-freeze sync debt)

sources-sync-2026-10-13.json.basis: 37 persons, 64 newSources, 427 index-field triplets (the transcription pass on the founder's live session)

image-bytes (NOT COMMITTED — C:/Users/tr.basis: 314 downloaded images / 84,055,524 B box-local; custodian agreements restrict republication; the only public artifact is the digest summary

private tier (NOT COMMITTED — sources-ha.basis: estate privacy law: raw transcriptions, notes, contributor ids, living households never leave the box

custodianCensus.method: title-regex bucketing of records.json collection titles (this qualification's own pass; bucket boundaries named below)
notes: us-federal bucket: underlying federal records are US public domain as works of the federal government; the FamilySearch-served SCANS and index remain custodian-licensed — public-domain status benefits a re-source-from-NARA lane, not redistribution of these bytes
partner-index-trees bucket carries the strongest index-restriction sensitivity (commercial/partner databases); its staged content is facts-and-citations only, no prose
church-records bucket is the founder's LDS-investor-family custodian context — context recorded, no rights claim made

acquisition.session: founder-signed-in familysearch.org session, the site's own UI wires, credentials never handled by agents
wires: dascloud das/v2/3:1:{ark}/name?namespace=apid (image binding) + image.xml + deepzoom tiles (images)
acquisition.discipline: pacing ≥160ms, single resumable worker (2,502 requests, 0 errors); walker-guard code-enforced queue law; only downloads and EXPLICIT site denials are outcomes; 2026-10-15 finding: FS shifted unauthenticated image.xml to 401-for-everything — denial banking now rides a session-plane verifier, guard code untouched
